name: kettlebell around head rotation
description: Circling a kettlebell around your head, also called a halo. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.
